slides.title: What does HRW say about The Reporter?
Rights group urges reversal
slides.body: Human Rights Watch says the government should lift the suspension, Nov 3.

slides.title: Authority's stated reasons
slides.body: Media Authority cites content against "national interests" and "distorted content" harming investment and diplomacy.

slides.title: HRW's concern
slides.body: It calls this part of an ongoing assault on media and civic space. No government response reported.

slides.title: Free press and fair process.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
